rcj_source_document: TX - 2026 - HHSC PCS Grant Award HHS0016568 - Texas Nurse-Family Partnership (TNFP) Program
why: A real, executed HHSC award list (14 grantees, $133,864,170) for the Texas Nurse-Family Partnership home-visiting programme, RFA released 2026-01-26. Its own s1.3: 'State funds for this Grant Project are authorized under the Texas General Appropriations Act, Article II' and federal funding through 'Temporary Assistance for Needy Families (TANF)', Assistance Listing 93.558 -- not RHTP's 93.798. 'Rural Health Transformation' occurs ZERO times in the RFA or the award notice. RCJ carries 14 of the 14 grantees ($133,864,170), 5 of them hospital districts or hospitals (Bexar County Hospital District; Dallas County Hospital District; Doctors Hospital at Renaissance; El Paso County Hospital District; Hillcrest Baptist Medical Center) -- Texas's Rider 88 shape again, and larger: §0.1 failure mode 1, the wrong programme, with real hospital names on real awards.
